description: Custom ListView subclass supporting drag-and-drop reordering with visual hover overlay and auto-scrolling.

classes.name: DynamicListView
classes.description: A custom ListView supporting drag-and-drop reordering with visual overlay and auto-scroll.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the list view, sets long click and scroll listeners, calculates scroll amount.

methods.name: getAndAddHoverView
methods.description: Creates a bitmap overlay (hover cell) of the selected view for dragging visualization.

methods.name: getBitmapWithBorder
methods.description: Returns a bitmap of the view with a black border drawn around it.

methods.name: getBitmapFromView
methods.description: Creates a bitmap snapshot of the given view.

methods.name: updateNeighborViewsForID
methods.description: Updates references to views above and below the currently dragged item.

methods.name: getViewForID
methods.description: Retrieves the view corresponding to a specific item ID.

methods.name: getPositionForID
methods.description: Gets the list position for a given item ID.

methods.name: dispatchDraw
methods.description: Overrides drawing to include the hover cell overlay.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events for drag-and-drop, including movement, release, and multitouch.

methods.name: handleCellSwitch
methods.description: Determines if the dragged cell should swap with neighboring cells based on movement.

methods.name: swapElements
methods.description: Swaps two elements in the list data.

methods.name: touchEventsEnded
methods.description: Finalizes drag, animates hover cell into position, resets state.

methods.name: touchEventsCancelled
methods.description: Cancels drag operation, restores original state.

methods.name: handleMobileCellScroll
methods.description: Handles auto-scrolling when dragging near list edges.

methods.name: handleMobileCellScroll
methods.description: Determines if list should scroll up or down during drag.
